# zero Learn — learn.zero.university

> zero is the platform where students do real, company-shaped work, get it scored against a professional bar, and get recruited on that proof. Free for students, recruiter-paid. Founded by Navid and Nadeem Nathoo, the team behind The Knowledge Society (TKS).

> Thesis: proof beats pedigree. A degree certifies that you passed a filter, not that you can do the work. The market now hires on demonstrated skill, so the lever that gets you hired is proof of real work a recruiter can see, not a credential. These guides answer student and early-career questions honestly, each with primary-source citations (New York Fed, Strada/Burning Glass, TestGorilla, NACE, BLS, Georgetown CEW).

> Main marketing site: https://www.zero.university. This subdomain hosts the Learn library.
